reply_text:
I can't set up a recurring 09:00 digest. I don't have a scheduling tool in this conversation, so nothing will arrive tomorrow unless someone else sets it up.

What I can do now: read #coastal-team (you're a member, so I can see it) and DM you a digest of anything new since a time you pick, such as yesterday or the last time you checked. Each digest would be a one-off, so you'd need to ask for it each morning. If you want it automated, someone with scheduling access will need to set up the recurring job.
